name: simgrid_add_radius_effect_huge_radius
description: Regression for AddRadiusEffect with radii and centres near the int32 limits: the window max(0, cx - R) .. min(countX - 1, cx + R) is computed without overflow. A 4 x 4 grid (64 x 64 cells, S = 16). r = 1e10, c = 100, o = 0 around tract (1, 1): R = 1e10 >= 16, so exact distances; k = float32(100 / 1e10) = 1e-8; every tract gets roundHalfEven(100 - d x k) = 100. Centre (2147483647, 0) outside the grid: every tract is about 2.1475e9 away (one float32 value), 100 - 21.47 = 78.53 -> 79. An int16 grid with centre (-2147483648, 3) and r = 3e9: k = float32(100 / 3e9), 100 - 71.58 = 28.42 -> 28 everywhere. Values from a numpy float32 model.
